description: x402 Listing Check: Seller-side pre-listing check: is my endpoint payable by a default x402 client? It validates the 402 shape of any endpoint — fetches it, reads the challenge, verifies accepts[] is complete (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), checks the published input example for placeholders, and measures the challenge against the 8,190 B edge line limit. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use before listing a new API.
name: x402-listing-check
